Decent game for free. Tons of customization options for cosmetics and player builds. It can take a while to earn necessary currencies to unlock the things you might want, but they're either free or cheap. It can be rather grindy, but it's not unfun, either. I'd suggest giving it a shot to see if it is your type of game. After all - it's free.

I love Rogue Likes.
I love Hero Shooters.
I don't love navigating the absolute labyrinth of a Main Menu. 

The navigation needs WORK, seriously. When I was playing, the game felt good (couple gripes about my character feeling like they're wearing cinder block shoes, but good). When I finish a run, I'm taken to a menu that actually makes me want to uninstall with how convoluted it is.

Another thing, how do you expect me to buy currency, with the intent of using it to convert into another currency, but not list the conversion rates before buying the initial currency? If I need Currency A to buy Currency B, maybe tell me  the conversion rate of A to B...?

I don't care about the characters needing play time/money to unlock in a F2P (noncompetitive) game. This game has much worse problems, and the biggest 1 is also the first thing you experience every time you play.

Had my friends ready to download this, but told them to hold off after testing it out. The Menu system is THAT bad.

TLDR: i'm trying to like the game MORE than I hate the menu.
reviews.developer_response:
Hi DoomTheSenpai,

Thank you so much for your detailed feedback! We really appreciate your thoughts, and we're sorry to hear that the menu navigation caused frustration. We completely understand how important intuitive design is, especially when it takes away from the flow of the game. We are already taking your feedback to heart and will definitely work on improving the navigation in future updates. We want players to feel comfortable and focused on the game, not overwhelmed by the menus.

As for the currency conversion, we completely see how not listing conversion rates can be confusing. We’re looking into making this clearer and more transparent so players understand what they’re getting before purchasing.

Regarding the unlocking characters and other systems, we appreciate that you find those manageable, and we hope that future improvements in navigation will make the game more enjoyable overall.

We’re a small indie team, and your feedback is incredibly valuable to us as we strive to improve. If you feel that these adjustments will help your experience, we’d greatly appreciate it if you could reconsider updating your review. Your support and honest input help us make the game better!

Thank you again, and we hope you’ll give the game another shot after we make improvements!

Updated Review 1 Year Later (Happy Anniversary!)

A big part of my previous performance issues were due to the weaker computer i was playing it on during season 0; partway through season 1 i got a stronger pc and a lot of the problems i was having were resolved. However I sadly still can't recommend the game for various reasons;

1) undisclosed gen-ai usage via the 2d sprites and english voices, and likely beyond that.
2) the gacha system for cosmetics is far from accessible, with insane prices being asked for for skins and f2p gacha opportunities being very few and far between.
3) while on a good computer smoothness will mostly be fine, there's a persistent frame stutter issue that still has not been fixed and too many enemies at once can cause severe lag.
4) half the characters are difficult to unlock without putting money toward the game; it also astonishingly took less than a year for them to stop putting in effort, as the latest rogueteer is just a blatant lazy reskin of a previous one.

I wish this could be communicated to the devs, but since this was likely a failed cash grab they gave up on it almost immediately, with the official discord being completely abandoned spare a few dedicated players just a few months after launch. There's no communication or current hope for saving it whatsoever, which is tragic because the game is very fun and has great potential that could be reached if they actually cared and fixed the issues mentioned above.
At this point i'm just enjoying it while i can before the global servers die :(
